title: Your Next Boss is an AI
full_monologue: **Your next boss will be an AI agent.** Imagine a leader that never sleeps, never gets distracted, and always makes data-driven decisions. AI agents are already managing tasks, analyzing trends, and even making strategic calls. They’re fast, efficient, and constantly learning. Soon, they’ll be in charge of teams, projects, and even entire departments. This isn’t sci-fi—it’s happening now. Are you ready to work for an AI?
